card.name: Negation and disclaimer wording
card.fires_on: Small words such as not, about, without, be, to and is right after a negation or disclaimer cue ("It is not", "Don't worry", "may be used without"). It also fires on some digits inside long ID or phone numbers.

modes.label: Words after negation
modes.description: A linking word that follows a negating phrase or sits inside a negative statement.
modes.example: It is<< not>> snitching — it is responsible reporting

modes.label: Disclaimer wording
modes.description: Small words inside legal or medical disclaimers about intended use or permission.
modes.example: It is neither intended nor implied<< to>> be a substitute for professional medical advice.

modes.label: Digits in ID numbers
modes.description: A digit inside an ISBN or phone number.
